title: Feedback:Game updates/20260813
wikitext:
== Update - August 13, 2026 ==

* Fixed an occasional client crash when logging in with an email-based account on PC.
* Increased the range of the [[Bird's Eye Compass|Birds Eye Compass]]. The extended range will only reveal additional parts of the map that are reachable by the player.
* Fixed an issue where some previously revealable parts of the map were no longer revealed.
* Fixed an occasional disconnect related to the Birds Eye Compass.

=== Guild Wars Wiki notes ===
* Build: 38,833.
